intro: Volcor is an injured night elf scout stranded deep within Blackwood Den in southern Darkshore. Trapped by hostile Blackwood furbolgs, he relies on his faithful companion Grimclaw and the aid of Auberdine's defenders to escape.

p: While tracking the corrupted Blackwood tribe in their subterranean lair, Volcor was ambushed and severely wounded. Unable to fight his way past the hostile furbolgs on his own, he sent his loyal bear companion, Grimclaw, out into the wilds of Darkshore to seek help from the settlement of Auberdine.
